versions.changelog: Balance and cost questions now answer from a live account read rather than from figures written into the package.

wealth-cover-set 0.1.1

- Initial release.
- Creates a four-to-eight still wealth cover set from user-supplied session names and themes.
- Customizes covers for session, destination, language, palette, and brand if provided.
- Free pack planning before any paid image generation; generates one still per named session.
- Only generates exactly as many covers as sessions named; does not invent or fill missing details.
- Billing, submission, confirmation, and delivery follow a clear, user-first workflow.
